title: Validation scan of the Osiris shaft

tellings.quote: We have measured also the the Osiris shaft Mm hm. which is well known as a structure.

plain: To check that their method worked, a scientist named Filippo Biondi says his team also scanned the Osiris shaft, a well-known underground structure at Giza in Egypt. Biondi uses scans to look beneath the pyramids, and he tells this as part of his own work. Testing the method on a structure everyone already knows is meant to show that the method can be trusted on the unknown ones.
